title: Bucs' Mayfield: Contract talks 'not anywhere close...

sources.name: ESPN NFL
sources.title: Bucs' Mayfield: Contract talks 'not anywhere close...
sources.description: Speaking publicly for the first time this offseason, Buccaneers QB Baker Mayfield said that contract extension talks "are not anywhere close to what we were thinking" and that it's "time to get something done long-term."
